positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered features requiring full-stack software development using C#, SQL, and React.
- Assisted in sprint planning, epic breakdown, story estimation, and technical planning.
- Diagnosed and resolved hot-fixes, release blockers, and critical bugs as necessary.
- Completed research stories and documented output with recommended story breakdown, potential challenges, proposed solutions, and estimated effort.
- Participated in UX meetings to provide engineering insight in application areas where I was the subject matter expert or I had performed relevant research.
- Coordinated with product and QA on current and future sprint assignments to ensure on-time active sprint completion and prepare future sprint work.
- Performed code-review and merged pull-requests.
- Coordinated with other internal teams & projects requiring application integrations (APIs).
- Worked on the development of several external API integrations and data acquisition services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Work with team members to produce SaaS product solutions using a microservices architecture that executes on a cloud-hosted environment. I contribute as a full-stack developer responsible for every layer of development including cloud configuration, database modeling and interaction, API interfacing and orchestration, and front-end development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Assist in the development of new technologies for workers on Railserve yards. This position involves both hardware and software development for embedded systems, and requires an understanding of linux and python.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Work to develop a virtual training simulation for Railserve, as a partner program with Kennesaw. Development heavily involves Unity and C#, as well as a broad array of other skills such as 3D modeling and animation.

positions.title: Motion Capture Lab Manager / Technician / Animator
positions.description: Setup, capture, clean, and process motion capture animations in a studio environment. I was heavily involved in the development of the lab as a new resource, and served as the first lab manager. As manager I coordinated lab use by students, acted as a source for help and instruction, and showcased the lab to approved visitors.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted students in-class as a teaching assistant, and outside of class as an official tutor to achieve a better understanding of data structures.

positions.title: Interactive Media Programming Intern
positions.description: Designed and developed mobile software applications in Unity for educational purposes in the department of veterinary resources. My primary responsibility was the development of a new application for graduate level students learning how to read radiographs.
